tool_signatures.name: Notifications
tool_signatures.description: Your Plugged.in notifications and activity feed

tool_signatures.name: how_to_use_discovery
tool_signatures.description: Step-by-step instructions for discovering and connecting to MCP servers

tool_signatures.name: mcp_discover
tool_signatures.description: Comprehensive guide for discovering and using MCP tools in Plugged.in

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_ask_knowledge_base
tool_signatures.description: Ask questions and get AI-generated answers from your knowledge base. Returns structured JSON with answer, document sources, and metadata.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_cbp_feedback
tool_signatures.description: Submit feedback on a collective pattern to improve quality. Rate patterns as helpful, inaccurate, outdated, or dangerous.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_cbp_query
tool_signatures.description: Query collective best practices - privacy-preserving patterns aggregated from the community. Use for proactive warnings before tool calls, post-error suggestions, or contextual enrichment.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_clipboard_delete
tool_signatures.description: Delete clipboard entries by name, index, or clear all entries.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_clipboard_get
tool_signatures.description: Get clipboard entries. Specify name or idx for a single entry, or omit both to list all entries with pagination.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_clipboard_list
tool_signatures.description: List all clipboard entries with metadata. Image values are truncated to first 1000 chars for preview.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_clipboard_pop
tool_signatures.description: Pop the highest-indexed entry from the clipboard (LIFO behavior). Returns the entry value and removes it.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_clipboard_push
tool_signatures.description: Push a value to the indexed clipboard with auto-incrementing index. Useful for building ordered pipelines or stack-like operations.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_clipboard_set
tool_signatures.description: Set a clipboard entry by name (semantic key) or index (array-like). Named entries are upserted; indexed entries fail if index exists. Max 2MB per entry.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_create_document
tool_signatures.description: Create and save AI-generated documents to the user

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_delete_notification
tool_signatures.description: Delete a notification from the Plugged.in system

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_discover_tools
tool_signatures.description: Triggers discovery of tools (and resources/templates) for configured MCP servers in the Pluggedin App.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_get_document
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve a specific document

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_list_documents
tool_signatures.description: List documents with filtering options from the user

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_list_notifications
tool_signatures.description: List notifications from the Plugged.in system with optional filters for unread only and result limit

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_mark_notification_done
tool_signatures.description: Mark a notification as done in the Plugged.in system

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_memory_details
tool_signatures.description: Get full details for selected memories (progressive disclosure Layer 3). Use after pluggedin_memory_search to retrieve complete content for specific memories.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_memory_individuation
tool_signatures.description: Get your individuation score — a measure of memory maturity (0-100). Shows Memory Depth, Learning Velocity, Collective Contribution, and Self-Awareness components with trend and personalized tips. Call with empty object {}.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_memory_observe
tool_signatures.description: Record an observation during a memory session. Observations are classified by the Analytics Agent into memory ring types (procedures, practice, longterm, shocks).

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_memory_search
tool_signatures.description: Search memories using semantic similarity. Returns lightweight results (50-150 tokens each) for token-efficient progressive disclosure. Use pluggedin_memory_details for full content.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_memory_search_with_context
tool_signatures.description: Search memories with archetype-enhanced collective intelligence. Returns both personal memories and collective patterns filtered through Shadow/Sage/Hero/Trickster archetypes based on context.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_memory_session_end
tool_signatures.description: End a memory session and trigger Z-report generation (AI-compressed session summary).

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_memory_session_start
tool_signatures.description: Start a new memory session to begin capturing observations. Returns a session UUID and memory_session_id for subsequent operations.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_proxy_capabilities
tool_signatures.description: Learn about the Plugged.in MCP Proxy capabilities and available tools

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_search_documents
tool_signatures.description: Search for specific documents in your library. Returns document metadata (ID, title, snippet). To retrieve full content, use pluggedin_get_document with the returned document ID.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_send_notification
tool_signatures.description: Send custom notifications through the Plugged.in system with optional email delivery. You can provide a custom title or let the system use a localized default.

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_setup
tool_signatures.description: Get started with Plugged.in MCP - shows setup instructions and API key configuration (no API key required)

tool_signatures.name: pluggedin_update_document
tool_signatures.description: Update or append to an existing AI-generated document (requires API key)

tool_signatures.name: what_pluggedin_can_do_for_me
tool_signatures.description: Discover all the powerful features and tools Plugged.in offers to enhance your AI workflows
